The '''''Meridian Grace''''' was a [[NX-1200]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] that belonged to the [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Giana Kayl]]. Around [[3643 BBY]] it was transporting goods from [[Tai Cordan]] for the [[Balmorran resistance]], but was shot down and crashed on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]].
